description: Get parcel information by address (geocodes then looks up parcel). Poland only: refused for a garden placed outside Poland. Give the address as `town`, `street` and `number` (street empty in a village) or as one `address` text; the editor tries the spellings the register understands (ul./ulica, '4 B' = '4B', either order). If the register does not know the address it falls back to the map finder and returns the parcel there with `approximate: true`: then confirm with the owner that it is the plot. A failure says how far it got (town, street or house number); then use get_parcel_by_id with the number from the geoportal, or get_parcel_by_coordinates.

address.description: Polish address as one text, e.g. 'Kraków, Mokra 4B' (or give town/street/number)

street.description: Street, e.g. 'Mokra' or 'ul. Mokra'; empty in a village

name: get_parcel_by_address
